actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.sendMessage.description: Send a message to an Orimon chatbot and get a response
actions.sendMessage.props.messageText.de: The message to send to the chatbot
actions.sendMessage.props.tenantId.descr: To get it: Login to your dashboard and click on the bot configuration page. At the top in the URL bar, copy the value starting after "tenant/" to the end.
auth.description:
To get your Orimon API Key:

1. **Login to your Orimon Dashboard**
2. **Click the profile icon** (image icon) in the Top Right corner
3. **Select "Profile"** from the menu
4. **Click "Generate Your Secret Key"** to create a new API key
5. **Click the eye icon** to reveal your key
6. **Copy the key** and paste it here

For more details, visit: [Orimon Developer API Docs](https://orimon.gitbook.io/docs/developer-api/getting-started-with-apis)
triggers.newLead.description: Trigger when a new lead is captured by your Orimon chatbot
triggers.newLead.props.markdown.descript:
## Webhook Configuration for Orimon

To enable this trigger, follow these steps to configure the webhook in your Orimon account:

### Step-by-Step Setup:

1. **Login to Orimon Dashboard** - [https://orimon.ai/login](https://orimon.ai/login).
2. **Go to Bot Overview**.
3. **Navigate to LeadFlow Integrations** - On the overview page, click on the **Settings** tab, then select **LeadFlow Integrations**
4. **Select Webhook** - Click on the "Webhook" option from the integrations page
5. **Paste the Webhook URL** - In the "Webhook URL" input field, paste the following URL:
```text
{{webhookUrl}}
```
6. **Submit** - Click the "Submit" button to save the configuration
